title: Generated Artifact Bulk Metadata Apply
problem: Accepted metadata Generated Artifacts can be applied one artifact at a time, but Nako has no guarded bulk apply plan, durable batch execution, partial-failure reporting, or Web Admin bulk workflow.

evidence.summary: Opened the bulk Generated Artifact Metadata Authority apply lane from GAMA closeout with a read-only bulk plan as the first executable task.

Added a redaction-safe read-only Admin bulk metadata apply-plan route with bounded explicit selection, duplicate accounting, per-artifact planned/missing items, aggregate counters, generated contract sync, and no Canonical Metadata mutation evidence.

Added durable bulk metadata apply batch persistence with idempotent batch replay, selection and summary snapshots, per-item redacted plan snapshots, deterministic item idempotency keys, guarded state transitions, and rollback evidence.

Added durable job-backed bulk metadata apply execution through the existing one-artifact apply path with per-item applied/noop/stale/failed outcomes, execution summary counters, terminal batch replay, and focused db/server evidence.

Exposed Admin bulk metadata apply confirm and status/result routes with redacted batch read models, route auth tests, idempotent replay, partial-result reporting, generated Admin TypeScript contract sync, and no Public Client route leakage.

Added the Web Admin bulk metadata apply workflow with accepted-artifact selection, live bulk plan/confirm/status data sources, fixture/fallback mutation guards, redacted partial-result display, route-state tests, browser smoke evidence, lazy-loaded Generated Artifacts page, and an explicit total-js gzip budget adjustment to 340 KiB.
